title: Financial Fraud Analytics
description: Explore transaction patterns and fraud labels in synthetic financial data. A Power BI report with transaction-type filters, KPI summaries and time-based views.
imageAlt: Financial fraud dashboard showing transaction totals, labeled fraud cases and fraud rates by transaction type
problem: Where are fraud-labeled transactions concentrated, and how do transaction types compare in a synthetic financial dataset?
approach: Built a Power BI report with measures for transaction count, transaction amount, fraud count, fraud rate and fraud-labeled amount. Added transaction-type filters, comparisons and simulation-time views.
outcome: The supplied report snapshot shows about 1.049 million transactions and 1,142 fraud-labeled transactions (0.11%). The visible fraud cases are in CASH_OUT (578) and TRANSFER (564). The report file is available for inspection in Power BI Desktop.
limitations: Synthetic data for portfolio analysis. Counts describe the supplied screenshot and its filter state, not a live financial system. Fraud-labeled amount is not money recovered or fraud prevented. Time-axis sorting and rate denominators should be checked before operational interpretation.
